brief:
The governor of Hebron called for international intervention after Israeli settlers forced approximately 1,500 Palestinians from their homes in the occupied West Bank since Friday, Middle East Eye reported. The mass displacement marked an escalation of settler activity in the city.

The Hebron governor did not specify the circumstances of individual expulsions or provide details on where the displaced Palestinians had relocated.
dek: More than 1,500 Palestinians driven from homes in Hebron since Friday The governor of Hebron has called for international intervention after around 1,500 Palestinians were forced from their homes in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli settlers drive 1,500 Palestinians from Hebron homes
